title: Infinite ECH Capacities and Anosov Flows
summary: This article relates the theory of embedded contact homology (ECH) with the dynamics of Anosov flows. We show that in many cases the ECH capacities of a symplectic 4-manifold are infinite, including cotangent disk bundles over closed oriented surfaces of genus at least two. We prove that ECH obstructs Reeb Anosov and Hamiltonian Anosov flows, addressing the four-dimensional case of a question posed by Herman in 1998.
